comment: Reviewed dependency allow-list for writ-broker (broker/DEPENDENCIES.md). The closure covers normal and build dependencies; path dependencies on workspace members are not listed. M3-02 adds hmac and sha2 (and writ-kernel by path); versions as reviewed for M1 (M1-07). BSD-3-Clause is approved for subtle 2.6.1 only (owner decision D-033), not as a general licence. Trusted time (owner decision 2026-11-12) adds rustix 1.1.6 (features: time only) and its closure; 'Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT' is approved for rustix 1.1.6 and linux-raw-sys 0.12.1 only, not as a general licence.

hmac.role: direct runtime (HMAC-SHA256 ingress seals and permits; constant-time verification); default features off

sha2.role: direct runtime (SHA-256 for HMAC); default features off; same version as writ-kernel

subtle.role: transitive (digest `mac` feature, enabled by hmac; constant-time tag comparison); licence BSD-3-Clause approved for this package only (owner D-033); notice in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md

libc.role: transitive, target-specific (cpufeatures: aarch64 Linux and Android; rustix and errno: libc backend targets); not compiled for the broker on x86_64 Linux

rustix.role: direct runtime (safe clock_gettime(CLOCK_BOOTTIME) for the trusted-time elapsed source); default features off, feature `time` only; build script runs rustc feature probes only; released 2026-10-27; licence approved for this package only (owner decision 2026-11-12), used under its MIT option
rustix.licence_approved: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

linux-raw-sys.role: transitive (rustix linux_raw backend on Linux; features auxvec, elf, errno, general, ioctl, no_std); released 2025-12-23; licence approved for this package only (owner decision 2026-11-12), used under its MIT option
linux-raw-sys.licence_approved: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

bitflags.role: transitive (rustix; default features off); same version as approved for writ-ledger-sqlite (rusqlite); released 2026-09-10

errno.role: transitive, target-specific (rustix libc backend: non-Linux Unix targets, the rustix_use_libc cfg, and Windows); not compiled on x86_64 Linux; pinned below 0.3.15 (released 2026-11-12) by the 14-day release-age rule; released 2025-09-09

windows-sys.role: transitive, Windows targets only (rustix, errno); not compiled on Linux; released 2025-10-06

windows-link.role: transitive, Windows targets only (windows-sys); not compiled on Linux; released 2025-10-06
